title: DPO Mardan Visits AWKUM; Assures Full Cooperation in Strengthening University Security
text:
Official University News

ABDUL WALI KHAN UNIVERSITY MARDAN

[Embedded document: https://www.blogger.com/video.g?token=AD6v5dyFGJQjJz5UxTrwZZ5gRdUNTGJ8-Jt7Gi8gXFRirENxZgDVyggep6wz6s9sWBYyQ05wiTslZR2q7XigNXKkRQ]

Highlights of the visit of DPO Mardan to AWKUM

District Police Officer (DPO) Mardan, Mr. Masood Ahmad
Bangash
, visited
Abdul Wali Khan University
Mardan (AWKUM)
on Wednesday, November 04, 2026, and
met with the Vice Chancellor,
Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad
.

The meeting focused on further strengthening security across
the University through close coordination with the district
administration and Mardan Police. Both sides discussed existing
security arrangements, surveillance systems, entry and exit
controls, and measures to ensure the safety of students, faculty
members, and university staff.

Focus of the Meeting:

Strengthening institutional security, improving coordination
with the district police, and ensuring a safe and secure
environment for the university community.

The Vice Chancellor thanked the DPO for his visit and support,
emphasizing that a safe and secure environment is essential
for the smooth conduct of academic and university activities.

The DPO assured the University of the full cooperation of
Mardan Police and reaffirmed the commitment to maintaining
close coordination with the University in the future.
